sam: Heads-up - we had a weird surge during the RBAC bulk-sync canary. Some tenants saw route fallback to shared pool even though roles looked unchanged.
zara: That rings a bell. Was the quota index stale after the migration job?
aj: Logs show bulk-sync edited role bindings first, then the quota reconciler ran ~30s later. Race.
maya: Oof. So the console preview could have shown a false positive during that window. We need stronger preflight checks.
chris: Proposal: add a bulk-preview API that evaluates N principals x M routes atomically against a specified policy_version (canary or active). Return per-item verdicts + confidence flags.
nina: Agree. Also include a `reconcile_token` in response so the UI can link to the reconciliation job if we detect a race.
sam: API sketch: POST /v1/preview/bulk with body: { principals: [...], routes: [...], policy_version: "canary" } -> returns array of { principal, route, allowed, quota, note } (note if result is based on partial snapshot).
zara: For UI we should show a compact table with color-coded rows and a banner when any row has "partial_snapshot" note.
aj: Telemetry: label these requests `preview:bulk` and add `policy_version` tag. Sample at 5%. Also emit `preview.bulk.result` metrics for counts of blocked vs allowed.
maya: Security: limit bulk preview to privileged admins and SRE tooling. Add rate limit. No preview for service accounts unless `allow_service_preview=true` flag.
chris: Implementation: reuse the snapshot cache but support multi-eval. Cache key = hash(route, policy_version, snapshot_id). For atomicity, preview should optionally lock snapshot by snapshot_id to ensure consistency across items.
nina: How to create snapshot_id? On policy change we can produce a new snapshot and make it immutable for preview. Create `POST /v1/policy/snapshot?policy_version=...` that returns snapshot_id.
sam: UX asks for cost estimate column: how many tokens/requests this principal is expected to use if allowed. We can show `estimated_rps` and `projected_monthly_requests`.
zara: Nice. Product wants an "impact score" combining quota tightness, traffic share, and SLA risk. Keep it simple (0-100).
aj: Ops note: previews touching many routes could create a lot of cache churn. Require `max_routes=50` in API to protect the cache.
maya: For the console, we also want a visual diff mode between policy_version=active and canary. So preview returns `baseline` and `candidate` fields for each item.
chris: Example response line (stringified in the thread):
```
{ principal: "team-a:svc-1", route: "model-alpha", baseline: {allowed:true, quota:50rps}, candidate: {allowed:false, note:"fallback to shared-pool"}, impact_score: 78 }
```

nina: Edge-case: scoped tokens that have a narrower scope than service accounts. Preview must respect token-bound principals and show `principal_type`.
sam: Migration plan: 1) implement snapshot API 2) bulk-preview backend 3) console table + diff + export CSV 4) staged canary behind feature flag.
aj: Add audit requirement: every bulk-preview should write a compact audit row (actor, principals_count, routes_count, policy_version) to the audit log stream, but redact principal ids for non-admin viewers.
maya: UI microcopy: "Bulk preview is an administrative tool. Results reflect the chosen policy version and snapshot. Use with caution."
zara: Also provide direct link from each row to route telemetry (last 1h, 24h) and to the quota config editor.
chris: Deploy plan: put the backend behind feature flag, test with internal tenants only, and run canary with 100 synthetic previews to exercise the cache invalidation path.
deploy-bot: canary started for service=rbac-preview, version=2026.03.21-bulk1 :rocket:
aj: Performance targets: p95 per-preview-item < 150ms with snapshots cached. If miss, allow background prefetch to warm cache.
nina: Invalidation: when quota or routing policy updates, emit `snapshot.invalidate:{policy_version}` events and garbage-collect snapshots older than 2h.
sam: Also: add a "dry-run apply" option in console to simulate performing the bulk sync and show resulting diffs in place. Must be restricted.
maya: I'll draft designs for table + diff + action buttons (export, open telemetry, request-grant).
zara: Can we add a small "risk meter" icon with hover help explaining the impact_score calculation?
chris: Yes, explainable score required. Keep formula stable across runs to avoid confusing admins.
deploy-bot: canary complete for service=rbac-preview, instances=4/4, status=healthy :white_check_mark:
aj: After canary we'll run a focused audit to ensure no previews caused side effects (no writes, all read-only).
sam: Thanks all. I'll open the RFC with API shapes and wireframes. Tagging @maya for mocks and @chris for endpoint contract. :thumbsup:
